documents.text: A turnbuckle is an adjustable connector used to change the tension or effective length of a cable or tie without rotating the members being connected.
A function is invertible on a domain when it is one-to-one there. Restricting a parabola to one side of its vertex can make its inverse a function.
DNS translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses. Recursive resolvers query authoritative infrastructure and cache answers for later requests.
Python context managers implement setup and cleanup around a block, commonly through __enter__ and __exit__ or the contextlib helpers.
Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System and is a gas giant. Its Great Red Spot is a long-lived storm.
Mitochondria generate much of a eukaryotic cell's ATP through cellular respiration and oxidative phosphorylation.
ঢাকা বাংলাদেশের রাজধানী এবং দেশের বৃহত্তম শহরগুলোর একটি।
الكعبة في المسجد الحرام بمكة هي قبلة المسلمين في الصلاة.
A database index is an auxiliary data structure that speeds up lookups at the cost of additional storage and write maintenance.
A Git branch is a movable reference to a commit. Feature branches let changes develop independently before they are merged into a stable branch.
